e130.label: violation

e131.label: violation

e140.label: violation

e150.label: violation

e151.label: violation
e151.note: canvas role=button handles clicks only within a painted hit region; unlike e23, the bitmap itself is the control, with no keyboard path

e160.label: ok
e160.note: working roving-tabindex toolbar entry; native Enter and Space activation and Left/Right/Home/End focus movement

e161.label: ok
e161.note: working toolbar item starts with tabindex=-1 but Tab to e160 then ArrowRight or End reaches it; skipping Tab is not itself a defect

e162.label: violation
e162.note: broken roving toolbar has all items at tabindex=-1; arrow handlers exist but no keyboard entry point; fresh trials avoid mouse-seeded focus

e163.label: violation
e163.note: second item in the toolbar with no initial tab stop; unlike e161, no reachable peer can transfer keyboard focus
